verdict.rationale: SumUp docs confirm webhooks exist but explicitly state the system 'only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout' — a single generic event type, not the granular authorized/captured/refunded/disputed lifecycle events the story requests. Refunds are documented as a separate API-driven action, not as a distinct webhook event, and disputes are not mentioned at all in the webhook docs. missing for 10: distinct webhook events for authorization, capture, dispute; documented dispute webhook; independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability.
